scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.predev: powershell -Command "try { $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conn) { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'Killed orphaned process on port 5001' } } catch {} exit 0"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron ."
